name: HumanApproval
summary: The gate: what is about to happen, and a person's decision.

a11y.apg: none — a labelled region holding the request and the two buttons

props.name: title
props.description: What is being asked for. Names the region for a screen reader when it is a string.

props.name: description
props.description: What will happen if this is approved, in plain words.

props.name: details
props.description: The exact parameters, as a DataList and not as prose: whoever approves needs to read what will actually run, and a paragraph hides a file path in the middle of a sentence.

props.name: risk
props.description: Three steps, measured from the reference.

props.name: deadline
props.description: When the decision is due. Shown as text — expiry is yours to enforce, because only you know what happens when it lapses.

props.name: decision
props.description: Once decided, the pair of buttons becomes the RESULT instead of disappearing. Disappearing erases the trace of what the person chose, and that is the difference between a record and a tidy screen.

props.name: onDeny
props.description: Fires on deny. Deny comes FIRST in reading and tab order: the destructive action should not be the first to take focus nor the easiest to hit without reading.
